Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Fraud Data Science team focuses on merchant fraud detection, account reviews, and interventions to protect Stripe and its users. We partner with Fraud Engineering and Risk Operations to turn data science into production systems and measurable improvements in fraud prevention. Our work includes evaluating how AI agents can support fraud investigations and review decisions while maintaining decision quality.

What you’ll do

We're looking for a Staff Data Scientist to help set the technical vision and roadmap for Fraud Data Science. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with cross-functional influence, with a particular focus on evaluating agentic approaches to merchant fraud detection and account reviews.

You'll define how we measure the quality and impact of these approaches, translate findings into technical priorities, and align partners on where and how to apply them. You'll bring scientific rigor and practical judgment to decisions that balance fraud prevention, operational efficiency, and the experience of legitimate users.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the team's technical vision and roadmap across merchant fraud detection, account reviews, and interventions, identifying opportunities where data science can have the greatest impact.
  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with Fraud Engineering, Risk Operations, Product, and other partners, turning ambiguous fraud problems into clear technical plans and measurable outcomes.
  • Define evaluation frameworks for AI agents used in fraud investigations and account reviews, including evaluation datasets, quality metrics, offline testing, and online experiments.
  • Combine model and agent evaluations with reviewer feedback and business outcomes to identify failure modes, guide iteration, and inform deployment decisions.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership in machine learning, statistical modeling, experimentation, and measurement, helping teams work through complex problems from research to production.
  • Develop approaches to measure the impact of fraud interventions, accounting for tradeoffs among fraud losses, review efficiency, and friction for legitimate users.
  • Translate technical findings into recommendations that influence priorities and investment across teams.
  • Raise standards for evaluation, reproducibility, and production monitoring, and mentor data scientists in their technical and professional development.
  • Lead complex projects from problem definition through modeling, implementation, and evaluation. Stay hands-on with analysis, code, and model development, and partner with engineering teams on production deployment.
  • Establish strong practices for model evaluation, monitoring, reproducibility, and analytical rigor.
  • Mentor data scientists and help peers grow their technical judgment, business understanding, and ability to deliver results.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of data science experience or equivalent combined industry and research experience in a quantitative field.
  • Bachelor's, master's, or PhD in a quantitative field, such as Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Operations Research, Physical Sciences, or Engineering.
  • Experience applying data science or machine learning to fraud detection, risk decisioning, or closely related adversarial problems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading initiatives spanning multiple teams or using deep domain expertise to influence technical roadmap planning and execution.
  • Strong grounding in machine learning and statistics, with experience designing rigorous evaluations and translating results into production or business decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to create alignment across technical and nontechnical stakeholders in ambiguous, complex situations and drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Ability to balance execution and velocity with research, statistical depth, and scalable design.
  • Proficiency in SQL and a computing language such as Python or R.
  • Proficiency with AI tools to accelerate model development, analysis, and coding.
  • Experience mentoring and investing in the development of peers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with merchant fraud detection, account reviews, or fraud interventions in payments or financial services.
  • Experience evaluating or deploying systems powered by large language models, including AI agents, with attention to reliability, failure analysis, and human oversight.
  • Experience developing evaluation datasets and quality metrics for complex decisions where ground truth is incomplete or delayed.
  • Experience taking machine learning or statistical systems from initial research through production deployment, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Experience designing experiments or applying causal inference to measure the impact of risk policies, review processes, or interventions

Working under the VP’s direction, you will draft, maintain, and drive adoption of policy to ensure that UK and EEA regulatory requirements are accurately reflected in the global framework.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe is beloved by developers for the simplicity of our APIs, the thoroughness of our documentation, and our focus on developer experience. The Technical Solutions Engineering (TSE) team is the glue that supports our developer-users and champions developer experience as being central to the overall experience of our users. TSE interacts directly with developer-users more than any other team at Stripe, so your role will have a significant impact on what Stripe is known for and values most. When we do our job well, developers all over the world are able to smoothly launch and grow their businesses on Stripe, whether they’re integrating payments for the first time or building complex financial systems.

What you’ll do

TSEs understand the fundamentals of programming incredibly well and eagerly jump in and familiarize themselves with others’ code. You will do a wide variety of things, including explaining technical concepts about Stripe’s products, build and debug integrations with developers, and produce/improve guides that help our users solve particular problems to be successful with Stripe. You will interact with developers of all skill levels through a variety of mediums, enabling them to be successful when using Stripe. 

Early on, current team members will devote a large amount of time to teaching you and helping you get to a level of comfort and expertise with Stripe, its services, and how we interact with users. Later, we’d love for you to take on this role with others on the team and Stripes broadly, as teaching is a great way to learn and to reinforce what you know.

If you’re someone who enjoys working with all kinds of code, is a fast researcher, a strong writer, and enthusiastic about helping others build mission-critical products with Stripe, we want to hear from you!

Responsibilities

  • Communicate with a number of external developers and aid them in building their applications against Stripe’s infrastructure in a number of programming languages (including Java, Python, Ruby, PHP, Go, NodeJS, .NET, ReactJS, React Native, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, and Java for Android).
  • Unblock external developers with their thorniest integration challenges through a variety of support channels including email, ticketing software, internal issue trackers, community platforms (like StackOverflow), and real-time chat software (like Slack and Discord)
  • Develop and maintain internal and external documentation, examples, integration demos, and code-snippets that demonstrate usage patterns of the Stripe infrastructure.
  • Identify points of friction developers encounter and collaborate with engineering teams to make Stripe products better. Participate in a number of extended engineering teams’ regular planning sessions, design reviews, and development meetings.
  • Develop and maintain a suite of internal support tooling for TSE and Stripe Support more broadly e.g. a retrieval augmented generation LLM-based Copilot tool or the Invoice Explainer Admin tool.
  • Act as a developer advocate and educational resource internal to the organization by regularly assembling training for non-developers internal to the organization and responding in real-time to product integration questions.

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • At least 4 years of full-stack software development experience, with a proven track record of building web or mobile applications that deliver high-quality user experiences
  • Direct experience explaining technical concepts, and would be comfortable explaining how Stripe works to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Understands how to write good, clean code in multiple programming languages, as well as how to read code that might not be quite as well written
  • Ability to help users during working hours in the region you are in. This may occasionally include providing weekend coverage for monitoring/supporting critical infrastructure, which TSEs are uniquely equipped to assist with given the team’s knowledge around Stripe’s products and active integrations. The team is largely remote, and we are very supportive of working arrangements that allow for family care and other needs to be met.

Preferred qualifications

  • Enjoys writing in a clear and quick manner
  • General software engineering skills are important to us, as we understand that new languages and frameworks can be learned if you understand the concepts

About The Role

We're hiring a Fraud Data Scientist to be the analytical brain behind our fraud models. You'll dig into how our models and rules are performing, spot where fraud is shifting, and tell the team exactly which features, signals, and strategy changes will move the numbers.

You'll work on fraud across card, bank, and alternative payment rails, for merchants in gaming, marketplaces, remittance, and ecommerce, where fraud patterns shift weekly. You'll partner closely with the engineers who build and deploy our models, plus risk operations and compliance, turning data into decisions they can act on. You'll be hands-on with AI-native tooling as a force multiplier for analysis, feature exploration, and experimentation.

What You'll Own

Model Performance Analysis: Track how our fraud models and rules perform over time and by merchant segment. Dig into approval rates, fraud loss, false positives, and drift, and explain what changed and why.

Fraud Trend Analysis: Spot emerging patterns early, from fraud rings and account takeover to card testing, friendly fraud, and bonus abuse. Size the impact and get ahead of it before it shows up in chargebacks.

Feature Recommendations: Explore transaction, device, behavioral, identity, and network data to find new signals. Prototype and validate features, then hand engineering a clear, evidence-backed case for what to add to the models.

Label Quality & Feedback Loops: Own the ground truth. Make sense of delayed and noisy labels from chargebacks, disputes, and manual review, and flag where bad labels are misleading the models.

Experimentation & Evaluation: Design and analyze backtests, shadow tests, and champion/challenger experiments. Evaluate third-party fraud vendors against our own models on our data, and give a clear answer on what to trust.

Rules & Strategy: Partner with risk operations to tune thresholds, rules, and step-up authentication. Recommend decision strategies per merchant segment and quantify the tradeoff between loss and approvals.

Reporting & Explainability: Turn analysis into clear reporting for leadership, merchants, banks, and auditors: what drives model decisions, how performance is trending, and what we're doing about it.

  • You've used analysis to measurably improve production fraud models or rules: new features, better thresholds, lower loss, higher approvals

  • Solid grasp of the fraud problem space: card-not-present fraud, account takeover, card testing, friendly fraud, chargeback reason codes, and how fraudsters adapt

  • Comfort with messy, imbalanced, delayed-label data and the judgment to evaluate model performance honestly on it

  • Experience designing and analyzing experiments where a false positive and a false negative cost very different amounts

  • A strong feature intuition: you can look at a fraud pattern and propose the signal that would have caught it

  • Ability to explain model behavior and tradeoffs to merchants, risk ops, banks, and auditors in plain language

  • Familiarity with graph or network analysis for detecting linked accounts and fraud rings is a plus

  • Comfort working with AI-native tooling as a daily driver, or genuine excitement to start

The Alternative Insights and Strategy team brings together proprietary data, external data and insights from investment teams across the firm. It translates that information into clear views, portfolio allocation frameworks and client-ready content for alternative investments.

The team works closely with investment teams, portfolio managers, strategists and client-facing professionals across the firm.

This Vice President will be a senior writer for the Alternative Insights and Strategy team, responsible for turning investment views, research and data into clear, engaging and credible content.
